body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> Samsung Electronics presented ‘T9B’ (YP-T9B) mp3 player during CES 2007.
The T9B enables users to enjoy their favorite songs wire-free using compatible Bluetooth-enabled headphones.

While sharing the same features with T9, the T9B takes features a step further and allows consumers to listen freely with Bluetooth-enabled wireless stereo. It allows users to listen to music without worry about missing a call; if you have an incoming call, the players tells you and you can talk using embedded microphone within the T9B. When you finish talking, the T9B automatically turns on and takes you where you were with the music.
It features MPEG4 video playback, 1.8-inch QCIF+ LCD color screen, text viewer, photo viewer, flash games, FM radio and recorder, and 30 hours of audio and 6 hours of video playback.

Meanwhile, Samsung Electronics has been working together with Boston Scientific medical equipment company to help those with hearing difficulty to appreciate music with the T9B and ‘harmony sound processor from the Boston Scientific Company.
